title: Solar Muna, Battery Later?
audience: Homeowners on a budget planning storage later
premise: Adding a battery later is easiest with a hybrid inverter and a compatible battery; a grid-tied-only inverter needs an extra battery inverter (AC-coupled).
scriptBasis: Claude draft from the episode plan (data/episodes.json) title/angle, V1.1 brand lines; claims checked online 2026-11-25.

items: Handa na ba ang backup wiring?

cues.text: Puwede bang solar muna, tapos battery na lang sa susunod?
Puwede, lalo na kung hybrid inverter ang ilalagay mo ngayon.
Siguraduhin lang na compatible ito sa battery na balak mo.
Kung grid-tied inverter lang, puwede pa rin, pero may dagdag na battery inverter.
Itanong din kung handa na ang wiring para sa backup.
Planuhin na ngayon, para hindi ka magpalit ng inverter sa susunod.
Dahil ang gusto ni Kuya SoLight… naka-solar ka na, SoSmart ka pa!

sources.title: Adding a battery to a solar system: can you do it?
excerpts: With a hybrid inverter, a compatible battery can usually be added (DC-coupled).
With a standard inverter, an AC-coupled battery adds its own battery inverter.

sources.title: Backup power function
excerpts: Backup operation requires a compatible battery and the appropriate backup wiring/switching to separate the home circuits from the grid.

sources.title: Battery-backup function
excerpts: Battery-backup operation must be set up and wired as a backup system.

sources.title: "Battery Ready" Solar Systems, And How To Buy One
excerpts: "Battery ready" is used loosely; being able to simply add batteries later requires a hybrid inverter, so confirm what the seller means.
